notes.title: New Creaks update adds save slot selection
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33807864/349fd2694dcbe5fa77449317f9698ccb6d9d3c17.png

A new Creaks update (Windows & Mac) just landed on Steam! 

Aside from the usual bug fixes, there's a new feature for those who'd like to use multiple save slots on just one Steam profile. With this update, you can choose from three separate save slots at the new selection screen. These saves are shared across Windows and Mac platforms if you have Steam Cloud enabled.

You'll be able to access the slot selection screen either at startup or from the main menu.

Enjoy! ːmuchomurkaː
